title: Immunohistochemical Labelling of Spinal Cord Neurons Involved in Bladder Activity
author: Janet R Keast
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bakkicuw

steps.title: Cryoprotect spinal cord tissue
steps.instruction: Place fixed L5‑S2 spinal cord in PBS (0.1 M, pH 7.2) containing 30 % sucrose and incubate at 4 °C for 24–72 h before sectioning.

steps.title: Embed and section tissue
steps.instruction: Embed the cryoprotected tissue in a cryomold with OCT, freeze in the cryostat, cut 40 µm sections, and collect sections sequentially into sets of four wells to obtain a series spaced 160 µm apart.

substeps.instruction: Embed tissue in OCT within a cryomold.
Freeze the block in the cryostat.
Collect sections progressively across sets of four wells to achieve 160 µm spacing.

steps.title: First PBS wash
steps.instruction: Wash the sections in PBS three times, 10 min each wash.

steps.title: Block sections
steps.instruction: Incubate sections in blocking solution at room temperature for 2 h.

steps.title: Primary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate sections with appropriately diluted primary antibodies (or antibody combinations) in PBS containing 0.1 % sodium azide, 2 % horse serum, and 0.5 % Triton‑X for 48–72 h.

steps.title: Second PBS wash
steps.instruction: Wash the sections in PBS three times, 10 min each wash.

steps.title: Secondary antibody incubation and counterstain
steps.instruction: Incubate sections with appropriately diluted secondary antibodies in PBS containing 2 % horse serum and 0.5 % Triton‑X for 4 h in the dark; optionally add NeuroTrace (1:100) to the incubation as a counterstain.

substeps.instruction: Prepare secondary antibody solution in PBS with 2 % horse serum and 0.5 % Triton‑X.
Add NeuroTrace at 1:100 dilution if desired.
Incubate sections for 4 h protected from light.

steps.title: Third PBS wash
steps.instruction: Wash the sections in PBS three times, 10 min each wash.

steps.title: Mount sections with anti‑fade medium
steps.instruction: Mount sections onto glass slides, coverslip, and apply a preferred anti‑fade mounting medium.

steps.title: Image and count labeled neurons
steps.instruction: Tile‑scan complete spinal cord sections (maintaining rostral‑to‑caudal order), then count and classify nucleated neuronal profiles based on immunoreactivity.

substeps.instruction: Perform tile‑scan imaging of each section.
Record the order of sections (rostral to caudal).
Classify neurons according to their immunoreactivity.
